name: months of background-only passes, then the server empties the drive: every local file survives
description: DEGOO-003 (sync-chaos srv-account-never-deleted, mobile-camera-upload): Degoo deleted accounts for 'inactivity' though the phone uploaded weekly. Rules C3, D1 and D2: no time-based decision on the client (a clock 120 days on changes nothing), and a drive emptied by the server is a held mass delete, never a local one.

name: background uploads count as activity for the retention policy
description: DEGOO-003: whether an account counts as active is the server's accounting (rule V7).
not_applicable: activity accounting and retention are token-server policy (sync-chaos srv-account-never-deleted, dc mode); AzDrive's stand-in remote has no accounts
